title: Three vessels
description: Three individually drawn ceramic forms reveal mineral grain, glazed rims and wheel marks as the selection moves into focus.
useCase: Give a compact object comparison a clear focal point while leaving every alternative visible.
interaction: Hover, focus or select a vessel.
reducedMotion: Focus and opacity states change immediately for keyboard use and reduced motion. Host pause disables selection.
limitations: Original SVG material illustrations with stylized lighting and static procedural grain, not photographs or physically based ceramic rendering.
look: Warm beige studio wall and shelf holding three illustrated ceramic vessels in sage, cream and terracotta, with serif names beneath and the unselected pots blurred.
motion: Hovering, focusing or clicking a vessel sharpens it while the other two blur 1.15 px and fade to 62% opacity over 240 ms; its name gains an underline.
adapt: Focus is pure CSS: `button:not([aria-pressed=true]) .object` sets `blur(1.15px)` and `opacity:.62` with a 240 ms transition, keyed by `selected`. Replace the `vessels` data and `Vessel` SVG drawing with product images.
